test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

ABILITY : ITYLABI :: INSTEAD : EADTINS :: ENGLISH : ?
solution:
Here, we need to find the pattern to get the missing word.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72a30b8cfc6309b36506bcbabb6647d5379494fca9023856cca8a5a79bf064f.png] 

The pattern here is: The first three letters are written at the last, then the 4th letter remains in the same place and the last 3 letters are written first.

So, we have:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c06c26845fce9a06b22069afc2d271bc3925b1a08276083fd77876403ece401.png] 

and [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53b303b62e87107adfd0e1a074bcd5a07abe77d89e3b21ab94d52d243922bffd.png] 

Thus, going with the pattern for the word ENGLISH, we will get the answer as: ISHLENG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/347414b32ffcbf495ec1acfca79527a3a2d2990ffc950d469b25afb41fae93ca.png] 

Hence, the word '__**ISHLENG**__' is related to the fifth term.
